releaseName: See your progress at a glance
notes: Every debt now has a progress bar that runs from red to green as you pay it down, with a marker showing exactly where you are, plus how much you've paid and how much is left.
Each debt now carries a colored stripe for its type (credit cards, student loans, auto loans and so on), so a long list is easier to scan.
The Add a Debt form has a short guide explaining each field: where to find your balance and APR, what the due day is for, and what to do with a 0% promo. Close it with the × once you don't need it.
New to the app? It now starts in the light theme. If you already use it, nothing changes, and you can switch themes any time in Settings.
If you use the light theme, the app no longer flashes dark for a moment each time it opens.
